#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using llong = long long;

llong dp[30];

llong calc(llong x){
    if(x <= 6) return x;
    llong ans1 = 1e9, ans2 = 1e9;
    
    for(int k = 0; k < 20; ++k){
        if(dp[k] > x){
            ans1 = calc(x % dp[k-1]) + k * (x / dp[k-1]);
            break;
        }
    }
    for(int k = 0; k < 20; ++k){
        if(dp[k] >= x){
            if(dp[k] - x >= x) ans2 = 1e9;
            else ans2 = calc(dp[k] - x) + (k + 1);
            break;
        }
    }
    
    return min(ans1, ans2);
}

int main(){
    dp[0] = 1;
    for(int i = 1; i < 18; ++i)
        dp[i] = dp[i-1] * 10 + 1;

    llong target; cin >> target;
    cout << calc(target) << '\n';
    
    return 0;
}
